Loss report: gitlab -> forgejo
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ping ext.passthrough: inline child jobs (the child pipeline ci/ping.yml runs inline as jobs ping-go; without strategy: depend the trigger job passes when the child pipeline starts, so jobs that need it wait for its own needs only; a failed child job now fails the pipeline; a variable that a run sets by hand reads as unset in the child conditions, as GitLab does not forward it without forward:pipeline_variables, but its value can reach the scripts of the child jobs; a return to GitLab restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ping-go job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ping-go step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/ping-go/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
